name: euler2d_naca0012
title: NACA 0012, inviscid, Mach 0.8 and 0.5 at alpha 1.25 deg (2D Euler, C-domain, GCI)

reference.source: Vassberg and Jameson (2010), J. Aircraft 47(4), Table 11, p. 1165: mean of FLO82 0.356209, OVERFLOW 0.351663, CFL3D 0.348226
reference.shortfall: Prompt 8-2 study (wall AND far-field sizes halved together: 14,523 / 40,388 / 136,920 cells, LU-SGS): Cl 0.3349 / 0.3325 / 0.3352, flat within 0.8 % over a 9 x refinement (the middle mesh stopped at 40,000 iterations, residual limit cycle), so the 4.8 % gap is no longer a mesh error (the 7b study refined only the wall size). Most likely cause, NOT yet tested: the far field. The C-domain is 30 chords with a plain characteristic far-field condition and no point-vortex correction; the circulation of a lifting airfoil decays only like 1/r, which lowers Cl on a small domain (Vassberg and Jameson use far fields of about 1e5 chords; their CFL3D run without the vortex correction gives the lowest value, 0.348). Next: a domain-size study (30 / 100 / 300 c) or a far-field vortex correction. Cd (3.6 %) and the Mach 0.5 lift (1.7 %) are within their tolerances.

notes: Reference (Vassberg & Jameson 2010, Table 11, p. 1165): Mach 0.8, alpha 1.25 deg: continuum Cl 0.3482 (CFL3D) to 0.3562 (FLO82), Cd 0.02245 to 0.02268; Table 10: Mach 0.5, alpha 1.25 deg: Cl 0.17978 to 0.18035, Cd -> 0 (FLO82 4.5e-8).
Cm here is about the quarter chord (template convention); the reference's Cm is about the quarter chord as well.
Mach 0.8, Cl: GCI observed order 0.19, extrapolated value 0.357282, GCI fine 8.23 %, GCI coarse 8.8 %, asymptotic ratio 0.952 (oscillatory convergence).
Mach 0.8, Cd: GCI observed order 2.78, extrapolated value 0.0217546, GCI fine 0.102 %, GCI coarse 0.629 %, asymptotic ratio 1.134 (oscillatory convergence).
Mach 0.5, Cl: GCI observed order 0.59, extrapolated value 0.182948, GCI fine 3.63 %, GCI coarse 2.56 %, asymptotic ratio 0.494.
Mach 0.5, Cd: GCI observed order 1.56, extrapolated value 0.000131506, GCI fine 39.1 %, GCI coarse 67.6 %, asymptotic ratio 0.668.
Mach 0.5 drag on the three meshes: 0.000475, 0.000287, 0.000191 (inviscid subcritical flow has zero drag; it must fall with refinement).
